## What's changed

- Made the player Home and Library screens load much faster on servers with large local libraries by reusing the decoded media index instead of reopening and parsing it repeatedly during each request.
- Kept the cached library snapshot synchronized with automatic and manual scans by invalidating it as soon as a newly scanned index is installed.
- Prevented slow initial library responses from making Apple TV and other clients appear to lose their server pairing.

This is a server-side update; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
